sloka: सुषेणः पश्चिमद्वारं गतस्तारापिता हरिः ।आवृत्य बलवांस्तस्थौ षष्टिकोटिभिरावृतः ।। ६.४२.२६ ।।।।
transliteration: suṣeṇaḥ paścimadvāraṁ gatastārāpitā hariḥ ।āvṛtya balavāṁstasthau ṣaṣṭikoṭibhirāvṛtaḥ ।। 6.42.26 ।।।।

translations.english: Sushena, father of Tara, (Vali's wife) the mighty, stood with sixty crores of monkeys at the western gate.
